title: Gradient estimates for generalized double phase problems with two modulating coefficients
summary: We prove local Calderón-Zygmund estimates for distributional solutions to non-uniformly elliptic equations in divergence form modeled on the energy density $a(x)G(|z|)+b(x)H(|z|)$, where $G$ and $H$ are Young functions and $a(\cdot)$, $b(\cdot)$ are nonnegative coefficients, Hölder continuous with exponents $α$ and $β$. Either coefficient may vanish, and only their sum is bounded away from zero, so that each phase can dominate or disappear.
